title: Create Textures - Refined Cooking
description: Create Textures - Refined Cooking adds new textures to make Refined Cooking look in the style of Create. Refined Storage/ Refined Cooking is required. Like what you see? See more like items in our main modpack,  Velox Resurrected.
body:
This only changes the look of blocks, you will still need the original mod.

As such, Refined Storage/Refined Cooking is required, as this only changes the appearance and not the recipes.

![Fox jumping into the snow gif](https://c.tenor.com/40fbDiP0vCIAAAAd/minecraft-fox.gif)

Like what you see? See more like it in our main modpack,  Velox Resurrected.
